notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Plaguemaw Beast does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Plaguemaw Beast.
description:
Activate Plaguemaw Beast by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Plaguemaw Beast, untapping Plaguemaw Beast.
Resolve the Plaguemaw Beast ability from step 1, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Repeat.
